title.en: Houthis Target Riyadh as Saudi Arabia Reports Missile Attack
title.zh-TW: 胡塞武裝（Houthis）瞄準利雅德（Riyadh） 沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）通報飛彈攻擊

summary.en: Houthis launched ballistic missiles toward Saudi capital Riyadh, with one reported strike on a fuel depot at the airport causing delays. Saudi Arabia stated it shot down the missile. The Iran-backed group also fought Saudi-backed forces in Yemen while seeking to expand territory.
summary.zh-TW: 胡塞武裝（Houthis）向沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都利雅德（Riyadh）發射彈道飛彈，據報擊中機場燃料庫造成延誤。沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）表示已擊落飛彈。該伊朗支持團體同時在葉門（Yemen）與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）支持的政府軍交戰，試圖擴張領土。

body.en:
Lede: Houthis targeted the Saudi capital with ballistic missiles amid rising tensions, while also battling for more territory in Yemen.
What happened: BBC World reported Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles, noting a strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays. NPR World stated Saudi Arabia says Houthis tried to attack its capital, marking the first such targeting since escalation. NYT World described Houthis pushing to expand territory as tensions with Saudi Arabia rise, with fierce battles against Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen.
Why it matters: The attacks and ground fighting signal renewed escalation between the Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia in the Yemen conflict.
Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm missile attempts on Riyadh and ongoing Yemen battles involving Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.
Still uncertain: Exact outcomes of the missile strike and current territorial gains remain unspecified beyond reported delays and clashes.
body.zh-TW:
導語：胡塞武裝（Houthis）以彈道飛彈瞄準沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都，同時在葉門（Yemen）爭奪更多領土，緊張情勢升高。
事件經過：BBC World 報導胡塞武裝（Houthis）聲稱以彈道飛彈瞄準沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都，利雅德（Riyadh）機場燃料庫遭擊中導致延誤。NPR World 指出沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）表示胡塞武裝（Houthis）試圖攻擊首都，此為升級以來首次。NYT World 描述胡塞武裝（Houthis）推動擴張領土，與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）支持的葉門（Yemen）政府軍激戰。
重要性：飛彈攻擊與地面戰鬥顯示伊朗支持的胡塞武裝（Houthis）與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）在葉門（Yemen）衝突再度升溫。
來源一致與分歧：所有來源均確認利雅德（Riyadh）飛彈企圖及葉門（Yemen）胡塞武裝（Houthis）與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）支持軍隊的交戰。
仍未確定：飛彈攻擊確切結果與目前領土 gains 除延誤與衝突外未有細節。

title.en: Friedrich Merz Vows to Stay After State Election Losses for CDU
title.zh-TW: 梅茲（Friedrich Merz）在基民盟州選失利後誓言留任

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz described his centre-right CDU party's losses in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin state elections as a disaster but vowed to remain in office and press ahead with reforms. The far-right Alternative for Germany party gained significantly while the CDU finished behind far-right and far-left parties.
summary.zh-TW: 德國總理梅茲（Friedrich Merz）將其所屬中間偏右基民盟在梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞與柏林州選的失利形容為災難，但誓言留任並推動改革。極右德國另類選擇黨大幅獲利，基民盟則落後於極右與極左政黨。

body.en: Lede: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faced major setbacks as his centre-right CDU party suffered damaging losses in state elections. What happened: Exit polls showed the CDU losing ground in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin. Merz called the results a disaster yet vowed to stay on and press ahead with reforms. The far-right Alternative for Germany party made significant gains, and the CDU finished behind far-right and far-left parties in eastern state elections. Why it matters: The defeats highlight growing pressure on Merz's leadership and rising support for the Alternative for Germany party in eastern states. Sources agree/disagree: BBC, NPR and NYT all report Merz vowing to continue despite the losses and note gains by the Alternative for Germany party. Still uncertain: Details on exact vote shares or next political steps remain limited to the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：德國總理梅茲（Friedrich Merz）面臨重大挫敗，其所屬中間偏右基民盟在州選中遭受嚴重損失。 事件經過：出口民調顯示基民盟在梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞與柏林失利。梅茲將結果稱為災難，但誓言留任並推動改革。極右德國另類選擇黨大幅獲利，基民盟在東部州選中落後於極右與極左政黨。 重要性：這些失利凸顯梅茲領導壓力增大，以及德國另類選擇黨在東部支持度上升。 來源一致／分歧：BBC、NPR與NYT均報導梅茲誓言繼續留任，並提及德國另類選擇黨獲利。 仍不確定：確切得票率或下一步政治行動細節僅限於所提供報導。

title.en: Ed Sheeran Breaks Silence on Israel-Gaza at Philadelphia Show Amid Macklemore Tour Controversy

summary.en: Ed Sheeran addressed Israel-Gaza and tour controversy at his first Philadelphia show after Macklemore's removal for pro-Palestinian remarks. He admitted mistakes, emphasized freedom of speech, and later apologized while thanking fans. SNL UK mocked him for fence-sitting and Dropkick Murphys' Ken Casey criticized his stance.
summary.zh-TW: 埃德·希蘭（Ed Sheeran）在費城首場演唱會上回應以色列-加薩議題與麥克勒莫爾（Macklemore）因挺巴言論遭移除巡演的爭議。他承認錯誤、強調言論自由，稍後道歉感謝粉絲。英國週六夜現場（SNL UK）嘲諷他騎牆，Dropkick Murphys主唱肯·凱西（Ken Casey）批評其立場。

body.en: Lede: Ed Sheeran spoke openly about Israel and Gaza during his Philadelphia concert, his first since the Macklemore controversy. What happened: The singer admitted mistakes and stated he could no longer hide his feelings on the issue. He described being placed in the middle of a debate on freedom of speech and the most complex political issue. The show ended with Sheeran apologizing for his political speech while tearing up and thanking fans. SNL UK cold open mocked him for sitting on the fence. Dropkick Murphys frontman Ken Casey said Sheeran took the knee with Macklemore and that it does not sit right with him. Why it matters: The remarks highlight tensions around celebrity statements on Israel-Gaza and their impact on tours and public perception. Sources agree/disagree: Outlets agree Sheeran addressed the topic at the Philadelphia show and later apologized; they differ on emphasis, with some focusing on his speech and others on external criticism. Still uncertain: No further details on specific positions stated by Sheeran beyond the reported quotes.
body.zh-TW: 導言：埃德·希蘭（Ed Sheeran）在費城演唱會公開談論以色列與加薩，此為麥克勒莫爾（Macklemore）爭議後首場演出。 事件經過：歌手承認錯誤，並表示無法再隱藏對此議題的感受。他描述自己被置於言論自由與全球最複雜政治議題的辯論中間。演唱會結束時，希蘭為政治發言道歉，邊哭邊感謝粉絲。英國週六夜現場（SNL UK）冷開場嘲諷他騎牆觀望。Dropkick Murphys主唱肯·凱西（Ken Casey）表示希蘭向麥克勒莫爾屈膝，這讓他感到不對勁。 為何重要：這些言論凸顯名人對以色列-加薩表態引發的巡演與公眾觀感緊張。 來源一致與分歧：各媒體一致指出希蘭在費城演唱會談及議題並後續道歉；強調重點不同，有些聚焦其發言，有些則報導外界批評。 仍未確定：除已報導引述外，希蘭具體立場無進一步細節。

imageAlt.en: Cover related to: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang

title.en: Google Threat Intelligence Infiltrates TeamPCP Supply-Chain Hacking Gang
title.zh-TW: Google 威脅情報（Google Threat Intelligence）滲透 TeamPCP 供應鏈駭客集團

summary.en: Google’s threat intelligence group revealed an undercover analyst infiltrated the TeamPCP hacker group. The group tainted hundreds of open-source programs with malware, stole developer accounts, released a Dune-themed self-spreading worm, and breached more than a thousand companies before two alleged members were arrested in Australia last month.
summary.zh-TW: Google 威脅情報小組（Google Threat Intelligence）揭露一名臥底分析師滲透 TeamPCP 駭客集團。該集團在澳洲兩名涉嫌成員上月被捕前，污染數百個開源程式、竊取開發者帳戶、釋出以 Dune 為主題的自傳播蠕蟲，並入侵超過一千家公司。

body.en: Lede: Google’s threat intelligence group disclosed details of an undercover analyst who infiltrated the notorious TeamPCP supply-chain hacking gang. What happened: Before two of its alleged members were arrested and charged in Australia last month, the hacker group known as TeamPCP carried out a hacking spree. It tainted hundreds of open-source programs with its malware, stole developer accounts to perpetuate that software supply-chain hacking, and even released a Dune-themed self-spreading worm to automate the process, ultimately breaching more than a thousand companies. Why it matters: The operation highlights the scale of software supply-chain attacks and the role of threat intelligence teams in disrupting such groups.
